name: Mudunuru Limited
about: Mudunuru Limited provides software services in India. The company provides financial technology solutions; biometric solutions, including biometric attendance systems, biometric access control systems, and national ID programs; education technology solutions; and smart city technology solutions, as well as solutions in the areas of smart parking management and intelligent transportation systems. It also engages in research and development activities. The company was formerly known as Green Field Agri Ventures Limited and changed its name to Mudunuru Limited in August 2016. Mudunuru Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Visakhapatnam, India.
